description: Edit the listing ManyCP sends to every directory. Send only the fields you want to change; the rest stay as they are. Fields: title (max 100 characters), short_description (max 100 characters, because the official MCP Registry rejects longer), description (long text, Markdown is fine), categories (up to 5 ids), tags (up to 15, lowercase words), tools (the FULL list of {name, description}, it replaces the old list), homepage_url (an empty string clears it). Saves at once. Directories that already list the server keep their current text until the next sync or submit. Version, packages and repo come from GitHub and cannot be edited here. Needs a launch credit, Starter or Pro.

categories.description: Up to 5 category ids. Replaces the current categories.

description.description: The long description, max 5000 characters. Markdown is fine.

homepage_url.description: A full http(s) URL. Empty string clears it.

server.description: Which server: its id (srv_...), its slug, its GitHub repo (https://github.com/owner/name or owner/name), or its exact name. list_servers shows them all.

short_description.description: One plain sentence, max 100 characters. Say what it does and for whom. Empty string clears it.

tags.description: Up to 15 short lowercase tags, like 'weather' or 'postgres'. Replaces the current tags.

title.description: Display name, max 100 characters. Empty string clears it.

tools.description: The complete list of tools. It replaces the current list, so include the ones that stay.

description.description: What the tool does, one or two sentences.

name.description: The tool's name exactly as the server exposes it.

name: update_listing
title: Edit a listing
